subject: MAP: compliance checkpoint playbook — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA & retention
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@finorion.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finorion.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — compliance gates needed (SOC 2, SIG, DPA, retention)

Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finorion is ready to move toward a scoped POC, but our legal and security teams have a fairly prescriptive acceptance path. Before we lock dates, can you confirm that Redwood can commit to the following checkpoints in a Mutual Action Plan (we're targeting an 8-week evaluation window):

- SIG/CAIQ: complete questionnaire review + follow-up Q&A within 2 weeks of MAP sign-off
- SOC 2: provide control mapping and sample artifacts for relevant controls within 3 weeks
- DPA: we need a draft DPA redline and confirmation of hosting/data transfer clauses within 2 weeks
- Data retention: confirm retention tiers (PII / logs / KV cache) and deletion SLAs for EU and US data

Attached is Finorion's security intake (Finorion_Security_Requirements.pdf) — high level. What would you propose as owners and exact dates for the checkpoints? We want to avoid hidden blockers that could delay procurement.

Best,
Alex
Security Program Manager
Finorion Payments
[Attachment: Finorion_Security_Requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@finorion.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — compliance gates needed (SOC 2, SIG, DPA, retention)

Hi Alex —

Really appreciate the clarity. We've sketched a short MAP that maps each checkpoint to a Redwood owner and a proposed delivery window. See the attached Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf for the visual plan, but summary below: 

- MAP sign-off: target 06/04 (owner: Jordan Blake) — formalizes scope and artifacts list
- SIG/CAIQ review: deliver our answers + clarifying follow-up by 06/11 (owner: Kimberly Park)
- SOC 2 control mapping & sample artifacts: deliver mapping by 06/18, sample artifacts (S3 ACLs, access logs, incident playbook snippet) by 06/23 (owner: Kimberly Park)
- DPA redline: initial redline back to you by 06/16 (owner: Irene Choi) — please flag any commercial items that need sales involvement
- Retention & deletion: documented tiers and deletion SLAs by 06/11 (owner: Jordan Blake + Kimberly)

Next steps I'd propose:
1) If this timeline looks reasonable, sign the short MAP (one-page) so we both commit to milestones.
2) Kimberly will schedule a 30-min intake call to walk the SIG and SOC 2 artifact list with your security team.
3) Irene will circulate the DPA redline and a DocuSign link for edits.

I've linked the HubSpot record for the deal in case you want to attach internal notes: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/RDW-DEAL-2026-045

I'll attach the MAP + a condensed SOC 2 controls extract for your review.

Thanks — we'll aim to keep this tight so procurement can start parallel legal review.

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex@finorion.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — compliance gates needed (SOC 2, SIG, DPA, retention)

Jordan / Alex —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick technical clarifications and what we'll deliver: 

- SIG/CAIQ: we'll send a completed CAIQ export (answers + short notes) and mark any "partial" items that require a follow-up demo. Expect that by 06/11.
- SOC 2: our 2025 Type II report covers relevant infra & ops controls. For the MAP, I'll produce a control mapping (which Finorion controls map to our evidence) and a short artifact pack (user access lists, rotated key logs, sample incident timeline redacted) — mapping by 06/18, artifacts by 06/23.
- Data retention: quick note — we use tiered retention. PII (identified data) default 180 days; session/analytics logs 90 days; cached KV is TTL-based and ephemeral (configurable). For EU data we can set region-specific retention and offer deletion hooks (API + documented process). I will include the precise retention clauses and a sample deletion request workflow by 06/11.

A few asks for your security team before our intake call: 
- Can you share the top 5 SIG questions that are deal blockers for you? (we'll pre-annotate)
- Are there special evidence custody requirements (e.g., SFTP vs secure SharePoint)?

Thanks — I'll book a 30-min slot for next week and include a short checklist to accelerate artifact pickup.

Kimberly Park
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-controls-extract.xlsx (xlsx)]

Alex —

Forwarding our internal notes and the initial DPA redline. High level: we can accept Finorion's standard data residency request for the POC (US regional hosting) with a limited clause for EU production that will require a substitution/addendum. The main redlines where I'd like your feedback: 

1) Liability cap: we've proposed a mutual cap tied to fees for the initial POC period — see page 2, paragraph 4.
2) Data processing instructions: added explicit language for customer PII deletion requests with a 14-day acknowledgment and a 60-day completion window for standard deletion (we can shorten if required for the POC).
3) Subprocessors: we'll disclose subprocessor list and provide 30-day notice for changes; if you require prior approval we can add a carveout for critical subprocessors only.

Next steps: I'll send the DocuSign packet with the DPA redline (https://docusign.net/Tx12345/redwood-dpa). If Finorion wants faster turnaround on the liability cap or data deletion SLAs, loop in your procurement and legal.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
